answer: Each earning key originates one RPKI-valid IPv6 /48 and serves a signed nonce from inside it, so looking glasses treat the live route as its routing anchor. Shared ASNs, IRR orgs, or upstreams collapse to one seat, so 20 aliases need 20 prefixes and 20 origin ASNs at about $200 a year each plus a BGP host. Paper ROAs with no collected route sit in a quiet lagoon of unused space and earn nothing. Borrowed LOAs and late more-specifics fail a 90-day RPKI first-seen check and RIPE RIS flags; even a zephyr of extra announcements still shares one origin.
